pages.title: A Recipe in Your Palm
pages.text: A crafter already knows how to arrange materials. Give it a recipe’s image and aether, and it can keep working inside your pack.$(br2)$(l)Right-click to open it.$() Click the grid with samples; right-click to clear them. Samples are retained. Switch it on and close the screen to begin. Editing the pattern pauses it.

pages.title: Materials and Mimics
pages.text: Real materials come first. $(l)Matching aether mimics$() can fill missing ingredients for their additional generation fee. Fluid mimics also need empty buckets; recipes return those buckets normally.$(br2)Results and remainders go back into your pack. Missing resources or a full pack pause the work without taking a partial payment.
